info.name: MetaVox
info.summary: Metadata for team folders: columns, views, highlights and search, right in Files
info.description:
MetaVox brings structured metadata to Nextcloud team folders. Define the fields your team needs, fill them in right in the file list, and filter, sort, highlight and search on them, even in folders with hundreds of thousands of files. Your files stay untouched: the metadata is stored separately.
**Work in the file list** - **Metadata columns.** Your fields appear as columns in Files. Double-click a cell to edit it, or edit many files at once. - **Ten field types.** Text, long text, number, date and time, checkbox, dropdown, multi-select, web address, person and file link. - **Values you can trust.** Required fields stay filled, and every value is checked, however it arrives.
**See what matters** - **Views.** Save columns, filters and sorting per team folder, and switch between them in one click. - **Highlights.** Color cells by their value: overdue in red, due soon in orange, approved in green. - **Instant filter and sort.** Search a filter's values and narrow down thousands of files at once.
**Find it again** - **Search by field.** Filter Nextcloud's search bar on a field value, in one team folder or all of them. - **Saved searches as folders.** Keep a search as a folder in Files, always up to date. *(Nextcloud 33 and newer)*
**Work together** - **Live updates.** Changes appear for everyone at once, and a cell someone is editing is locked. - **Nextcloud's permissions.** You see and change the metadata of exactly the files you can, ACL included.
**Automate and connect** - **Default values.** New files get their team folder's defaults. - **AI suggestions.** Let AI read a file and suggest its metadata. - **Flow.** Act on metadata: notifications, access control, retention. - **WebDAV and REST API.** Ask for `<nc:metavox/>` in a PROPFIND to get every file's metadata with the folder listing, or use the OCS API. - **Backup and restore.** Daily backups, restored with one click.
**Built for** document classification, case and project files, contracts, policy management, curriculum tagging and research data. Used by universities, government organizations and enterprises.
Supports **Nextcloud 31 to 35** on **MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL**, in English, Dutch, French, German and Swedish. SQLite is for trying MetaVox out.
